d: From the first sparks in the workshop to the final motorcycle reveal, the OCC crew takes on ambitious custom builds that demand creativity, precision and teamwork. Watch the process behind incredible chopper motorcycles as the builders tackle fabrication, design challenges and the finishing touches that bring each custom bike to life. Catch American Chopper Season 2 Episodes 59, 47, 45, 43, 41, 40, 38 and 37 only on discovery+ India.
